name: comp-452

frames.best_why: Shows the whole bordered strip with the house icon, both links and the bright current page.

tagline: A breadcrumb trail boxed inside a thin rounded frame.
summary: A bordered rounded strip holding a house icon, the link Components and the brighter current page Breadcrumb, spaced along one line over black.
appearance: A slim rounded rectangle with a thin slate border and faint shadow rests on black. Inside, a house glyph, a chevron, the grey word Components, another chevron and the brighter Breadcrumb sit along one row.
behaviour: Hovering a link lifts it from grey to white while the frame and spacing hold still. Nothing else changes.
demo_content: Components and Breadcrumb, with a house icon.
search_phrases: outlined path strip with home icon
website trail with a frame around it
use_when: When the breadcrumb must read as a distinct control over busy page content.
avoid_when: On a flat page with no contrasting surface: the border and shadow need something to sit against.
customise: The labels, house icon and separators are fixed in the file; a real path means editing the items. Border, padding and shadow live on the list's class.
weight_why: A few text links, one icon and a border; nothing runs or animates.

a11y.note: The icon link carries hidden Home text so it has a name; focus styling is the browser default and nothing animates.

polish_why: Clean bordered strip with even spacing; the frame is its only distinguishing touch.
